testCase:
R-38: Find a nationwide nearest animal shelter for birds around zip 10012.
Goal: Find a nationwide nearest animal shelter for birds around zip 10012.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/r-38/
STEP 2: Click "Agree and continue"
STEP 3: Click "Find a shelter"
STEP 4: Fill "ZIP code" with "10012", choose "Birds" in "Animal type", choose "Nationwide" in "Search area" and "Distance" in "Sort by"
STEP 5: Click "Search shelters" (close the "Get adoption alerts" pop-up with "No thanks" if it appears)
STEP 6: Click "Skyward Aviary Rescue"
STEP 7: Verify "Opened: Skyward Aviary Rescue" is visible

plan.title: Find a nationwide bird shelter near ZIP 10012

steps.note: Verify that the specified shelter opened.

reasoning: This tests finding a bird shelter around ZIP 10012 with nationwide coverage and results sorted by distance. The plan follows the specified search flow and verifies that Skyward Aviary Rescue opens.
